messages:
lucy_runtime: Morning — PR #1173 is ready for cross-team signoff. It touches runtime batching, platform routing config, and an infra template change (IAM role). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1173. Need approvals from @mike_platform, @sanjay_infra, @ethan_security before the merge window at 18:00 PT. TL;DR: ~8% tail latency reduction when batching, adds optional env REDWOOD_EVICT_TIMEOUT, and a new IAM role for service-to-kinesis access.

mike_platform: Thanks — can you paste the routing config diff or the snippet that changes fallback behavior? want to ensure canary/fallback stays predictable.

lucy_runtime: Sure, excerpt below (small snippet):
```yaml
- route: default
  model: rwd-3b
  fallback: rwd-1b
+ route: default
+  model: rwd-3b
+  fallback: rwd-1b
+  fallback_policy: prefer_lower_latency
  batching:
    max_batch_size: 64
    max_latency_ms: 12
```
Note: fallback_policy defaults to previous behavior unless set; we explicitly set prefer_lower_latency to avoid cost-first routing. No change to canary weighting logic.

sanjay_infra: Quick question — does the new IAM role require org-level approval (service account with cross-account permissions)? If so we need an approval ticket. Also please run `make infra-plan` and paste the plan summary so I can verify there are no destroy actions.

lucy_runtime: Ran `make infra-plan` against the staging workspace. Summary: "Plan: 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy". Change is a new `aws_iam_role` + policy attachment for kinesis:Read/Write. Full plan excerpt: `~ aws_iam_role.redwood_kinesis -> update` (only policy binding). No state migration.

ethan_security: A couple of security checks from my side: 1) confirm KMS key usage for any secrets the role can access (no plaintext creds in repo), 2) ensure IAM policy least privilege (scope to stream ARN), 3) add a note in the PR about audit logging. If those are satisfied I can sign off.

lucy_runtime: Confirmed: KMS key is used for param store values referenced by the service, see `env/kms_key_id` in the template. Policy limits stream access to the `arn:aws:kinesis:us-west-2:123456789012:stream/redwood-*`. Added a short PR comment about audit logging.

mike_platform: I'll review the routing change and the canary interactions. If fallback_policy only prefers lower latency and doesn't change weight calculation I'll be fine. Expect to finish in ~45m.

sanjay_infra: I'll take the infra bits and aim to approve by EOD. If I need an org ticket for cross-account trust I'll open one and ping this thread.

lucy_runtime: Awesome — tagging @deploy-bot to hold merge until approvals are in. If we get all three approvals before 18:00 PT we can merge in tonight's window. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Merge hold placed for PR #1173 until approvals from mike_platform, sanjay_infra, and ethan_security are recorded. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you approve.

mike_platform: :white_check_mark: taking this as tentative approval (will post inline comments if I see anything else).

sanjay_infra: :white_check_mark: granting infra approval, opened ticket RD-4821 for cross-account trust just in case (no blockers).

ethan_security: Left two tiny comments on least-privilege scoping; once addressed I will :white_check_mark:.

lucy_runtime: Thanks all — I'll address Ethan's two comments now and update the PR. Will ping again when done.

(End of thread)
